front: When did the Portuguese build a fort at Sofala?
What happened to Gonçalo da Silveira in 1561?
back: He baptised the Mutapa but was killed on the king's orders.

front: When was the Barreto expedition, and why did it fail?
back: 1569-1573; disease, tsetse fly, African resistance, heat and poor supplies.

front: Why did the Portuguese come to the Zambezi valley?
back: Gold, ivory, rivalry with Swahili-Arab traders, Christianity, empire.

front: Why did prazeros become independent warlords?
back: Distance from Portuguese authority, private achikunda armies, wealth from trade, and local African alliances.

front: Name two Portuguese posts on the Zambezi.
Impact of the prazo system on Africans?
back: Loss of land, tribute and forced labour, slave raiding; also Afro-Portuguese culture and new crops.
